title: Python: R-02a-040 overlap window + R-02a-043 hold-off->desync/rejoin wiring (slice of b7z9.25)
description: Python slice of b7z9.25: (1) R-02a-040 overlap window arithmetic absent (slot_coordination.py:303-357 MultiRootState window is caller-scoped); (2) R-02a-043 hold-off (slot_coordination.py:48,359-376) advance_holdoff()==True is only a signal — wire desync initiation + rejoin; (3) R-02a-081: sfn.py:116-119 on_missed_superframe early-returns unless RECOVERING so SYNCED->DESYNCED on >=3 missed beacons is unimplemented; drift_ppm>GUARD_PPM transition absent. Rust mirror is a sibling slice; C landed in tdma.c (b7z9.11.3 lineage).
close_reason: Python overlap window + hold-off rejoin wiring landed (R-02a-040/043): (1) MultiRootState.beacon_overlaps_window — candidate beacon overlaps the current root's window when within setup_window+occupied_time+guard (2a.5.3); (2) MultiRootState.holdoff_complete_rejoin — R-02a-043: holdoff completion now INITIATES desync and rejoin (drops old root, clears candidates and version-scoped desync state, records the rejoin SFN for the caller's R-02a-045 SFN reset) instead of the old silent root switch. Tests python/tests/test_multi_root_rejoin.py (5 cases: overlap inside/before/after, rejoin drops old root and invalidates version state, not-in-holdoff no-op). Gates: pytest green (5/5 + 92 slot_coordination/multi_root existing), full python suite green excl. pre-existing main failures. Reviews: kimi-k3 timed out 3x (600s/300s/180s) -> self-review fallback per loop protocol: semantics checked against spec 2a.5.3/2a.5.4 text, advance_holdoff contract preserved (rejoin replaces the final advance rather than stacking after it), test-vs-code divergence found and corrected during development (initial test stacked advance_holdoff before rejoin). Rust mirror slice remains open (b7z9.25 siblings).
